messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] aroma.affymetrix documentation
parts:
Hi,

all documentation is online at the group page (see 'Pages'):

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix

There you should find everything needed to get started and some
example script that you can cut'n'paste. As a group member you can
updated or write your own pages, e.g. adding another example page.

Unfortunately I haven't found a way to "print all", or generate a PDF
that contains all group pages; you have to browse through them.

The R help pages that exist are more for the developer who wish to
write their extensions. There are also several methods that are not
documented in the R help. It is simply lack of time if a function is
not documented.

Hope this helps

Henrik
